```lean
:= by
  constructor
  intro n
  induction' n with d hd
  case zero => exact CategoryTheory.Limits.has_zero_object (ModuleCat R)
  case succ d =>
    let X := (ModuleCat R).obj (by infer_instance)
    let Y := (ModuleCat R).obj (by infer_instance)
    let i : X ⟶ X ⊕ Y := CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.inl
    let p : Y ⟶ X ⊕ Y := CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.inr
    let iso₁ : X ≅ X ⊕ Y := CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.ι₁_iso
    let iso₂ : Y ≅ X ⊕ Y := CategoryTheory.Limits.biprod.ι₂_iso
    exact { biprod := X ⊕ Y, inl := i, inr := p, ι₁_iso := iso₁, ι₂_iso := iso₂ }
```
